name: wame-work-mode
description: Two work modes for Claude Code: build and harden. Build mode builds fast — no tests, no Pint, no five-dimension self-check, no framework/docs lookups, no browser, no review agents — and records every touched file or screen in .claude/wame-deferred.local.md; a UserPromptSubmit hook reminds Claude of it on every prompt (pure bash, silent in harden mode). /wame-harden then runs every deferred check once, in order — tests for the touched areas (filtered, then the project's full suite), Pint --dirty, the five-dimension self-check (ui_ux, performance, security, reachability, framework), a security review and a code review (laravel-agents security-auditor and code-reviewer-laravel when installed), docs/CLAUDE.md updates and one visual pass via the chrome-devtools MCP if a UI changed — fixes the findings while keeping the agreed behaviour, look and texts, and switches back to harden. /wame-mode build|harden|status stores the mode in the project's .claude/wame-mode.local.md (git-ignored), read by laravel-agents, laravel-nova-agents, teamwork-task and teamwork-task-test; build mode can also switch off the security-guidance plugin's automatic Stop review via .claude/settings.local.json env (restored by harden — /wame-harden always runs a security review). Never installs or uninstalls Playwright, Puppeteer or Dusk for a single run: the chrome-devtools MCP or the project's own runner, and a missing runner is asked for once and installed permanently.
